cves: Applio is a voice conversion tool. Versions 3.2.8-bugfix and prior are vulnerable to unsafe deserialization in `infer.py`. The issue can lead to remote code execution. As of time of publication, a fix is available on the `main` branch of the Applio repository but not attached to a numbered release.
